known_issues.detail: Baseline-unsolved group (form2 hidden-set convention): under judging conditions, the shipped deterministic SA baseline with a fixed iteration budget per instance cannot produce a legal schedule with zero hard violations for these instances (ITC2021 hard constraints are difficult for a naive SA; full-set measurements are archived under tests/calibration/ and in the async package PROVENANCE). Under decision ③, record B=null. The hidden set also has 3 numeric-anchor keys where B>K across the board. After the batch-b-260920 remeasurement, the baseline on transformed instance h11 had one hard violation, so B changed from placeholder 4913 to null and scored-key count from 4 to 3. The temporary anchor adapter (fetch_best / fetch_final) excludes and records these; they are included when replaying with the finalized framework.
